item.title: Family awaits justice as anniversary of Richmond man's deadly shooting approaches
item.description: As the one-year anniversary of Antonio Roane's death approaches, his family is waiting for justice — and grieving a loss that has left six children without their father.

item.title: Mekhi Becton released by Chargers one year after winning Super Bowl with Eagles
item.description: One year after winning the Super Bowl with the Philadelphia Eagles, former Highland Springs standout Mekhi Becton is being released by the Los Angeles Chargers.

item.title: John Vithoulkas talks data centers, affordable housing, and Henrico's 'secret sauce' on Untold
item.description: Henrico County manager John Vithoulkas told Untold podcast host Catie Beck that 2026 could be his most challenging year yet.
